INSERT OVERWRITE paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d
SELECT
    r.dt,
    r.app_id,
    r.uid,
    r.register_event_id,
    r.register_event_time,
    r.attributed_channel,
    r.source_event_id,
    r.source_event_type,
    r.source_event_time,
    r.score,
    r.score_threshold,
    r.confidence_level,

    r.time_diff_seconds,
    r.reg_ip,
    r.reg_brand,
    r.reg_model,
    r.reg_system,
    r.reg_system_version,
    r.hit_ip,
    r.hit_brand,
    r.hit_model,
    r.hit_system,
    r.hit_system_version,
    r.rule_version,
    r.created_at,
    CASE
        WHEN s.uid IS NULL THEN r.rewrite_status
        WHEN COALESCE(c.is_rewrite_channel, 0) = 0 THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN r.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN r.attributed_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(r.attributed_channel) = ''
             OR LOWER(TRIM(r.attributed_channel)) = 'organic' THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN s.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.channel) <> ''
             AND LOWER(TRIM(s.channel)) NOT IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self', 'unknown')
             AND s.channel <> r.attributed_channel THEN CAST(NULL AS TINYINT)
        WHEN s.channel = r.attributed_channel THEN CAST(1 AS TINYINT)
        ELSE CAST(0 AS TINYINT)
    END AS rewrite_status,
    CASE
        WHEN s.uid IS NULL THEN r.rewrite_reason
        WHEN COALESCE(c.is_rewrite_channel, 0) = 0 THEN '未回写-app未灰度'
        WHEN r.attribution_status = 'unattributed'
             AND r.unattributed_reason = 'no_candidate' THEN '未回写-无候选'
        WHEN r.attribution_status = 'unattributed'
             AND r.unattributed_reason = 'score_below_threshold' THEN '未回写-低置信'
        WHEN r.attribution_status <> 'success' THEN COALESCE(r.rewrite_reason, 'organic-待归因')
        WHEN r.attributed_channel IS NULL OR TRIM(r.attributed_channel) = ''
             OR LOWER(TRIM(r.attributed_channel)) = 'organic' THEN '未回写-归因仍organic'
        WHEN s.channel IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(s.channel) <> ''
             AND LOWER(TRIM(s.channel)) NOT IN ('organic', 'natural', 'self', 'unknown')
             AND s.channel <> r.attributed_channel
            THEN COALESCE(r.rewrite_reason, '已有真实渠道-免归因')
        WHEN s.channel = r.attributed_channel
            THEN CONCAT('已回写-命中', r.attributed_channel)
        ELSE '未回写-渠道未变更'
    END AS rewrite_reason,
    r.score_brand,
    r.score_model,
    r.score_system,
    r.score_system_version,
    r.score_time,
    r.time_bucket_max_seconds
FROM paimon.dws.dws_register_attribution_result_d r
LEFT JOIN paimon.dim.dim_app_attribution_config_snap c
    ON r.app_id = c.app_id
   AND c.snap_dt = '${dt}'
LEFT JOIN paimon.dws.dws_user_snapshot_d_d_v2 s
    ON r.app_id = s.app_id
   AND r.uid = s.uid

WHERE r.dt = DATE'${dt}';

-- uid_dict_cand_page_visit_d · 页面访问取号候选（步 dws_app_page_visit_d_d 的 candSqlFile）
-- 候选 = 当天页面浏览明细非怪 uid；已有号取回、没号当场发，结果进临时视图 id_dict_codes，同会话跑 thenSql
-- 怪 uid 表达式与 uid_dict_cand_h.sql / uid_dict_cand_init.sql 逐字一致

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone=Asia/Shanghai;
SET spark.sql.adaptive.enabled=true;

CREATE OR REPLACE TEMP VIEW id_cand AS
SELECT app_id, uid AS id, CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMP) AS ord_t
FROM (
    SELECT app_id, TRIM(uid) AS uid
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
) e
WHERE app_id IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(app_id) <> ''
  AND uid IS NOT NULL AND uid <> ''
  AND NOT (uid IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest',
                      'test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
           OR uid RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
           OR LOWER(uid) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
           OR uid RLIKE '^__GUEST__')
GROUP BY app_id, uid;

-- task: dws_app_page_visit_d_d
-- doc: 页面访问日指标；停留读 paimon.dwm.dwm_app_page_stay_d；uid_cnt 字典号 bitmap（禁 hash64）
-- params: DT, OUT_DB
-- 本文件作 id_dict assign 的 thenSqlFile：先 cand 取号，同会话 join 临时视图 id_dict_codes
-- 怪 uid 不进 bitmap；非怪取不到号 raise_error 中断

SET spark.sql.session.timeZone = Asia/Shanghai;

INSERT OVERWRITE ${OUT_DB}.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d
PARTITION (dt = '${DT}') (
    app_id, page_key, page_name,
    pv_cnt, uid_cnt, entry_cnt, jump_cnt,
    valid_stay_sec_sum, valid_stay_page_cnt, stay_page_cnt, dropout_page_cnt,
    load_time_sum, load_cnt, etl_time
)
WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        uid,
        COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(current_page_key), '')) AS pk,
        NULLIF(TRIM(page_name), '') AS page_name,
        NULLIF(TRIM(referrer_page_key), '') AS ref_pk,
        page_load_time
    FROM paimon.dwd.dwd_app_page_view_d_r
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
      AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
),
base_f AS (
    SELECT * FROM base
    WHERE pk IS NOT NULL AND pk <> '' AND length(pk) <= 64
),
agg_page AS (
    SELECT
        bf.app_id,
        bf.pk AS page_key,
        MAX(bf.page_name) AS page_name,
        COUNT(*) AS pv_cnt,
        COALESCE(
            bm_union(
                CASE
                    WHEN bf.uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(bf.uid) <> '' THEN
                        CASE
                            WHEN (TRIM(bf.uid) IN ('null','NULL','Null','undefined','none','None','nil','me','guest',
                                      'test','unknown','UNKNOWN','N/A','n/a','(null)','-','0','1','-1','')
                                  OR TRIM(bf.uid) RLIKE '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
                                  OR LOWER(TRIM(bf.uid)) RLIKE '^(test|demo|dev|sample|fake|dummy)[_-]'
                                  OR TRIM(bf.uid) RLIKE '^__GUEST__') THEN NULL
                            WHEN c.uid_code IS NULL THEN CAST(raise_error(CONCAT('页面访问取不到 uid 号: ', bf.app_id, '/', bf.uid)) AS STRING)
                            ELSE CAST(c.uid_code AS STRING)
                        END
                END
            ),
            bm_empty()
        ) AS uid_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bf.ref_pk IS NOT NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(bf.ref_pk)) <> 'unknown' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS entry_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bf.page_load_time IS NOT NULL AND bf.page_load_time > 0 THEN CAST(bf.page_load_time AS BIGINT) ELSE 0 END) AS load_time_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN bf.page_load_time IS NOT NULL AND bf.page_load_time > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS load_cnt
    FROM base_f bf
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT app_id AS c_app_id, uid AS c_uid, uid_code FROM id_dict_codes) c
      ON bf.app_id = c.c_app_id AND TRIM(bf.uid) = c.c_uid
    GROUP BY bf.app_id, bf.pk
),
agg_jump AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        ref_pk AS page_key,
        COUNT(*) AS jump_cnt
    FROM base_f
    WHERE ref_pk IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(ref_pk)) <> 'unknown'
      AND pk IS NOT NULL
      AND LOWER(TRIM(pk)) <> 'unknown'
      AND ref_pk <> pk
      AND length(ref_pk) <= 64
    GROUP BY app_id, ref_pk
),
agg_stay AS (
    SELECT
        app_id,
        NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '') AS page_key,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stay_sec IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(stay_sec AS BIGINT) END) AS valid_stay_sec_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN stay_sec IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid_stay_page_cnt,
        COUNT(*) AS stay_page_cnt,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_dropout = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dropout_page_cnt
    FROM paimon.dwm.dwm_app_page_stay_d
    WHERE dt = '${DT}'
      AND uid IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(uid) <> ''
      AND NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '') IS NOT NULL
      AND length(NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '')) <= 64
    GROUP BY app_id, NULLIF(TRIM(page_key), '')
),
page_keys AS (
    SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_page
    UNION
    SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_jump
    UNION
    SELECT app_id, page_key FROM agg_stay
)
SELECT
    k.app_id,
    k.page_key,
    p.page_name,
    COALESCE(p.pv_cnt, 0) AS pv_cnt,
    COALESCE(p.uid_cnt, bm_empty()) AS uid_cnt,
    COALESCE(p.entry_cnt, 0) AS entry_cnt,
    COALESCE(j.jump_cnt, 0) AS jump_cnt,
    COALESCE(s.valid_stay_sec_sum, 0) AS valid_stay_sec_sum,
    COALESCE(s.valid_stay_page_cnt, 0) AS valid_stay_page_cnt,
    COALESCE(s.stay_page_cnt, 0) AS stay_page_cnt,
    COALESCE(s.dropout_page_cnt, 0) AS dropout_page_cnt,
    COALESCE(p.load_time_sum, 0) AS load_time_sum,
    COALESCE(p.load_cnt, 0) AS load_cnt,
    current_timestamp() AS etl_time
FROM page_keys k
LEFT JOIN agg_page p
  ON k.app_id = p.app_id AND k.page_key = p.page_key
LEFT JOIN agg_jump j
  ON k.app_id = j.app_id AND k.page_key = j.page_key
LEFT JOIN agg_stay s
  ON k.app_id = s.app_id AND k.page_key = s.page_key;

-- dws_app_page_visit_d_d Paimon。uid_cnt 存 BINARY（字典号 bitmap），与 SR bitmap 接口对齐。
-- 旧表若 uid_cnt 仍是 BIGINT：须 DROP 后按本 DDL 重建（类型变更不能原地改）。
-- OUT_DB 测试渲染 test，生产渲染 paimon。

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ${OUT_DB}.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d (
    app_id STRING,
    page_key STRING,
    page_name STRING,
    pv_cnt BIGINT,
    uid_cnt BINARY COMMENT '访问账号集合(字典号 bitmap)',
    entry_cnt BIGINT,
    jump_cnt BIGINT,
    valid_stay_sec_sum BIGINT,
    valid_stay_page_cnt BIGINT,
    stay_page_cnt BIGINT,
    dropout_page_cnt BIGINT,
    load_time_sum BIGINT,
    load_cnt BIGINT,
    etl_time TIMESTAMP,
    dt STRING
)
USING paimon
PARTITIONED BY (dt)
TBLPROPERTIES (
    'primary-key' = 'dt,app_id,page_key',
    'merge-engine' = 'deduplicate',
    'bucket' = '16'
);

-- 影子表。结构对齐正式表：uid_cnt 为 BITMAP（字典号回写）。正式表仍由海豚写。
-- test/prod 若旧影子 uid_cnt=bigint：须先 DROP 再按本 DDL 建（见 recreate_shadow_uid_bitmap.sql）

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `dws`.`dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow` (
  `dt` date NOT NULL COMMENT "业务日",
  `app_id` varchar(50) NOT NULL COMMENT "产品",
  `page_key` varchar(64) NOT NULL COMMENT "页面",
  `page_name` varchar(512) NULL COMMENT "页面名",
  `pv_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "访问次数",
  `uid_cnt` bitmap NULL COMMENT "访问账号集合(字典号)",
  `entry_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "进入次数",
  `jump_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "跳转次数",
  `valid_stay_sec_sum` bigint NULL COMMENT "有效停留秒",
  `valid_stay_page_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "有效停留页次",
  `stay_page_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "停留页次",
  `dropout_page_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "跳出页次",
  `load_time_sum` bigint NULL COMMENT "加载时长",
  `load_cnt` bigint NULL COMMENT "加载次数",
  `etl_time` datetime NULL COMMENT "写入时间"
) ENGINE=OLAP
PRIMARY KEY(`dt`, `app_id`, `page_key`)
COMMENT "页面访问影子表，Spark 回写；uid_cnt=字典号 bitmap，对齐正式表接口"
PARTITION BY RANGE(`dt`) ()
DISTRIBUTED BY HASH(`page_key`) BUCKETS 16
PROPERTIES (
"compression" = "LZ4",
"dynamic_partition.buckets" = "16",
"dynamic_partition.enable" = "true",
"dynamic_partition.end" = "3",
"dynamic_partition.history_partition_num" = "30",
"dynamic_partition.prefix" = "p",
"dynamic_partition.start" = "-10000",
"dynamic_partition.time_unit" = "DAY",
"dynamic_partition.time_zone" = "Asia/Shanghai",
"enable_persistent_index" = "true",
"fast_schema_evolution" = "true",
"replicated_storage" = "true",
"replication_num" = "3"
);

SET new_planner_optimize_timeout = 60000;
-- paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d -> dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow
-- uid_cnt：湖表 BINARY(字典号) → SR bitmap_from_binary
INSERT OVERWRITE dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d_paimon_shadow PARTITION (p${DTC}) (
    dt, app_id, page_key, page_name,
    pv_cnt, uid_cnt, entry_cnt, jump_cnt,
    valid_stay_sec_sum, valid_stay_page_cnt, stay_page_cnt, dropout_page_cnt,
    load_time_sum, load_cnt, etl_time
)
SELECT
    CAST(dt AS DATE), app_id, page_key, page_name,
    pv_cnt,
    bitmap_from_binary(uid_cnt),
    entry_cnt, jump_cnt,
    valid_stay_sec_sum, valid_stay_page_cnt, stay_page_cnt, dropout_page_cnt,
    load_time_sum, load_cnt, etl_time
FROM paimon.dws.dws_app_page_visit_d_d
WHERE dt = '${DT}';
